drift_phase.description: Arena initialization, curvature drift, and connection transport define GU’s drift-phase behavior. Drift is continuous and stable across S0–S2.
drift_phase.notes: Curvature and connection fields behave as classical drift operators with no paradox formation.

regime_phase.description: Observerse and dilaton coherence define GU’s regime-phase behavior. Coherence is strong but substrate-dependent.
regime_phase.notes: Observer alignment is partial; coherence stabilizes but tapers approaching Ω5.

coherence_phase.description: Spectral anomaly cancellation defines GU’s coherence apex. Coherence is strong but fragile near the physical boundary.
coherence_phase.notes: Spectral alignment begins to destabilize as Ω6 approaches.

regime_boundary.description: Physical regime collapse and utilization cliff. The operator cycle breaks at Ω6 → Ω0.
regime_boundary.notes: RTT detects a regime-boundary paradox requiring substrate alignment.

rtt_verdict: Geometric Unity is vertically continuous but horizontally incomplete. The Ω6 → Ω0 break is a regime-boundary paradox.
